subject: act-tr
title: ACT.TR.------EXPN.
description: Second diagram on page 472 (TRF(II)-8), paired with EXPN x PROG-CONT above. The crossing diagrams how actual-transformation structurally meets EXPN at the political-and-social-dynamics scale: ACT-TR (actual transformation) crossed with EXPN. ACT-TR sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; EXPN at upper-center as partner-axis. WO-UNF (world unification) upper-left, SPT-GH (spiritual growth) upper-center, TRS (transition) upper-right. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) right. SPT-GH hangs from an unlabeled line off the main line and carries WO-UNF. TRS rises from the main line and carries PROG-CONT and STF (source transfer); STF carries C-INFO (composite information), which carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which carries SG (source initiation). The lower-left line from the main line passes RT-ALGN (reality alignment) on its way to PHY-U-C (physical-universe context); SOC-RT-DEV (social-reality development) branches from it at RT-ALGN and carries SOC-PR (social programs).
